data.title: Future: docket deps graph - full dependency graph visualization
data.body:
Show the full dependency graph (or a filtered subset).

```
$ docket deps graph

Dependency Graph: 8 bugs, 11 edges

Ready to work (no blockers):
  ghi3: Choose database engine [Done] ✓
  jkl4: Design API endpoints [Approved]

Blocked chains:
  def2 ← abc1 ← mno5 ← pqr6
              ↖ stu7
  jkl4 ← abc1
```

## Export formats

- `--format dot` — Output Graphviz DOT format
- `--format mermaid` — Output Mermaid diagram syntax
- `--format json` — Programmatic consumption

## Future idea

Only implement if users need whole-project dependency visualization beyond individual tree views.
